02 / Functional scope

What is included — and what is not

A defined MVP scope for the Kolhapur launch. The first release focuses on reliable booking, workforce coordination and core operational visibility.

Included in ₹3.80 lakh

Fixed-scope MVP deliverables

  • ✓Two Android applications — Customer app and Service Professional app.
  • ✓Admin web dashboard for booking, customer, professional and service operations.
  • ✓Custom backend and PostgreSQL database with role-based access and versioned APIs.
  • ✓Scheduled and instant booking workflows with serviceability and capacity checks.
  • ✓Online and cash payment integration with transaction/collection status records.
  • ✓Basic worker allocation and manual dispatch, including assignment and reassignment.
  • ✓Push notifications for key booking events.
  • ✓Booking history and status tracking from confirmation through completion.
  • ✓Basic analytics and reports for booking, status and revenue/payment summaries.
  • ✓Production deployment and technical documentation.
  • ✓45-day post-launch bug-fix support for in-scope reproducible defects.

Not included

Can be scoped and quoted separately

  • –iOS application release or Apple App Store submission.
  • –AI-based automated dispatch optimisation or demand forecasting.
  • –Advanced live GPS tracking and route optimisation.
  • –Voice AI booking or multilingual conversational assistant.
  • –Subscription and loyalty systems, including rewards and automation.
  • –Advanced multi-city automation beyond the initial Kolhapur configuration.
  • –Website and marketing campaigns, SEO and social media campaign services.
  • –AWS, SMS, Maps and payment gateway usage fees or other third-party charges.
  • –Major new features after scope approval; these require a separate change request.

Mobile OTP access, address management, service discovery, ASAP/scheduled booking, checkout, online/cash choice, status, history, ratings and support.

05 / Assumptions & terms

Clear responsibilities. Clear boundaries.

The project schedule and estimate rely on timely client inputs, third-party account access and approval of service operations before configuration sign-off.

Client inputs & responsibilities

Provide brand assets, approved service names, descriptions, scope, prices, durations, working hours, zones and booking policies. Provide legal/business details, privacy policy, terms, cancellation/refund rules and support contacts. Nominate one decision-maker and UAT users. Manage worker recruitment, verification, training, scheduling, service quality, payouts, cash collection and field operations.

Third-party accounts

Client owns and funds AWS/cloud, Google Play Console, payment gateway merchant, maps and SMS/OTP accounts. Account approval and provider availability are outside Syntova's control. One production environment and one initial Kolhapur service configuration are included.

UAT & acceptance

Syntova provides a test build and UAT checklist. Client reviews and reports reproducible issues against the approved scope within 5 business days of milestone submission. Sign-off or a mutually documented issue list closes each milestone.

45-day bug-fix warranty

45 calendar days from production handover for reproducible defects that cause delivered software to materially deviate from the approved specification. New features, changed requirements, third-party outages/changes and unauthorised modifications are excluded.

Change requests

Features, integrations, workflows or design changes outside this quotation require a written change request with cost and timeline impact. Work begins only after written approval.

Source code & handover

Project-specific source code and agreed technical documentation are handed over after full payment of all undisputed project invoices. Syntova retains pre-existing tools, reusable libraries, know-how and generic components. Third-party software remains subject to its own licence.

Confidentiality, data & third-party dependencies

Both parties use reasonable safeguards for confidential information. The client remains the data controller/business owner for customer and professional data and must approve privacy, retention and access policies. Payment gateway, maps, cloud, SMS, app-store and notification services follow their own terms, pricing, availability and approval processes. Syntova cannot guarantee third-party review or uptime. Syntova implements approved client content but does not provide legal or tax advice.

Frequently clarified

A few important boundaries

Does the development amount include AWS and payment gateway charges?

No. Cloud hosting, storage, bandwidth, SMS/OTP, maps, gateway transaction charges, domain and app-store fees are excluded from the one-time development fee. Indicative running costs are shown in Section 04.

Is instant booking guaranteed within 10 minutes?

No. ASAP booking returns the earliest feasible appointment based on configured working hours, eligible professional availability and capacity. The quotation does not promise a 10-minute arrival.

Is ongoing support included?

A 45-day post-launch bug-fix warranty is included. After the warranty, an optional AMC is available at ₹12,000 per month. New features and major enhancements are separately estimated.

When does the project timeline begin?

The 14–16 week estimate begins after written approval, receipt of the 70% advance and kickoff. Delays in client inputs, approvals, provider activation or feedback can affect the schedule.

What does “GST not charged” mean in this quotation?

GST is not charged by Syntova under this quotation. Third-party providers may separately charge taxes on their own services. This quotation is subject to Syntova's applicable tax status and accounting treatment.
